name: Earthshape — a pump cast on the land after the spell does not raise the bound
notes: (2026-10-18) The board Earthshape resolved against holds only what came before it in the timeline: Giant Growth cast on the Forest afterwards makes it 6/6 on the board, but the bound stays 3 (a 0/0 creature with the three counters put on before the spell), so Hill Giant qualifies and Craw Wurm (6/4) does not.

scryfallData.name: Hill Giant
scryfallData.flavor_text: Fortunately, hill giants have large blind spots in which a human can easily hide. Unfortunately, these blind spots are beneath the bottoms of their feet.

scryfallData.name: Craw Wurm
scryfallData.flavor_text: The most terrifying thing about the craw wurm is probably the horrible crashing sound it makes as it speeds through the forest. This noise is so loud it echoes through the trees and seems to come from all directions at once.

scryfallData.oracle_text: Earthbend 3. Then each creature you control with power less than or equal to that land's power gains hexproof and indestructible until end of turn. You gain hexproof until end of turn.

scryfallData.flavor_text: "Cap called for Giant-Man, not Ant-Man. Something big must be going down."
